# Test fixtures provenance

The prose snippets in `sample_book.py` and the generated `sample.epub`
are original to this repository. They are short, narrative prose written
specifically as test material for `epublate`'s round-trip tests, and are
dedicated to the public domain via [CC0
1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) — no rights
reserved by the contributors.

The binary `sample.epub` is regenerated by running:

```bash
uv run python -m tests.fixtures._build_sample
```

Regenerate after editing `sample_book.py`.
